card.name: Digits inside years, IDs and citations
card.fires_on: Mostly a digit partway through a number in web text, such as a year (2010, 2007), an ISBN, a DOI, a URL code or a journal volume. It also fires on a few proper names like Mir or Child Labour.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A single digit inside a longer year, ISBN, DOI or URL number in a citation.

modes.label: Years in news text
modes.description: The last digit of a year such as 2007 or 2010 in a news sentence.

modes.label: Odd name pieces
modes.description: A scattered name or term part, like Labour, NET or Mir, in news or tech text.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a mix of Chinese terms, URL pieces and names, so it adds no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on digits inside dates, ISBNs and citation numbers in ordinary web text.
